title: Fernhaven Seed Library — Annual Report 2023 (extract)
text: At the close of 2023 the catalogue stood at 912 varieties, up from 861 the year before. The library remains run entirely by volunteers — thirty-one gave time this year — and carries no paid staff. Our April Seedling Swap drew the largest crowd in its history. Lending remains free to all members, on the usual promise that growers return saved seed in the autumn. Income again came from member donations and small grants, including the continued support of the Carrow Coast Community Fund.
notes: First-party annual-report register. Sole precise collection figure in Set A (912 varieties, consistent with the almanac's 'roughly nine hundred'). Corroborates volunteer staffing, the April festival, free lending, and donation-and-grant funding.
